items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Zoot came and did a concert with us.

ctx.x: Zoot, yeah. Zoot came and did a concert with us. Now I’d sort of heard the name but you know, an older swing guy, and again, I didn’t know nothing. I really didn’t know what

this guy had done. I mean I heard him in the Woody Herman band recordings or something like that but I was basically totally ignorant. But all I knew was — and you know he was such a like a slight, quiet character, I mean physically slight. He wasn’t like a big strapping guy. But he seemed very low key, very quiet. It’s not like I really talked to him or hung out or got to know him or anything. But when he started to play that saxophone, then it really struck me. That’s how a saxophone’s supposed to sound. That’s…
